comment: Bench-local Claude headless recipe for the with/without-DoFlow A/B (decision D2: not in core/registry/harnesses.json). Every flag below cites the line it was read from. 'help' = `claude --help` of claude 2.1.308 (read 2026-10-30). 'probe' = behaviour observed offline against an unreachable endpoint (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9, fake key, scratch HOME; no model call). 'docs' = code.claude.com via context7 /websites/code_claude. Nothing here was run against a real model.

parser.feed: stdout, one line at a time (parser.create().line(text); .end())

prompt.comment: probe: `printf hi | claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose` reached the API retry loop (prompt consumed); with empty stdin and no argument it exits 1 with 'Error: Input must be provided either through stdin or as a prompt argument when using --print'.

argv.comment: help: '-p, --print  Print response and exit (useful for pipes).' Workspace trust dialog is skipped in this mode (same help entry).
help: '--output-format <format>  Output format (only works with --print): "text" (default), "json" (single result), or "stream-json" (realtime streaming)'.

REQUIRED with -p + stream-json. probe: without it claude exits 1 with 'Error: When using --print, --output-format=stream-json requires --verbose'. help: '--verbose  Override verbose mode setting from config'.

help: '--include-hook-events  Include all hook lifecycle events in the output stream (only works with --output-format=stream-json)'. probe: arm B emits system/hook_started and system/hook_response (SessionStart:startup exit_code 0, UserPromptSubmit) before system/init; arm A emits none. This is the P3 evidence (hooks fired).

help: '--model <model>  Model for the current session. Provide an alias ... or a model's full name.' probe: init.model echoed 'claude-sonnet-5-5'. Value is the plan's bench pin (ab-bench-plan-result.md section 5); the user approves the pin at execution.

help: '--permission-mode <mode>  (choices: "acceptEdits", "auto", "bypassPermissions", "manual", "dontAsk", "plan")'. probe: init.permissionMode echoed 'bypassPermissions' (no root, outside a sandbox the start succeeded). Decision: both arms. docs (hooks-guide): PreToolUse hooks fire before any permission-mode check, including bypassPermissions; docs (agent-sdk/permissions): 'Hooks still execute'.

help: '--disallowedTools, --disallowed-tools <tools...>  Comma or space-separated list of tool names to deny'. probe: init.tools lacked WebFetch and WebSearch with the flag and listed both without it.

help: '--strict-mcp-config  Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config, ignoring all other MCP configurations'. With no --mcp-config this leaves zero MCP servers. probe: init.mcp_servers was [] in both arms (arm B installed with --mcp none).

forbidden.comment: help: '--bare  Minimal mode: skip hooks (those defined in settings and by installed plugins ...) ... and CLAUDE.md auto-discovery ... Anthropic auth is strictly ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'. It would delete arm B (hooks, CLAUDE.md), so it is never passed.
help: 'Enable automatic fallback to specified model(s) when the default model is overloaded'. It would change the model mid-run, so the pin would not hold. Not passed.
help: 'Start with all customizations (CLAUDE.md, skills, ... hooks, ... agents ...) disabled'. Would delete arm B. Not passed.
help: 'Disable all skills and commands'. Would delete arm B. Not passed.

help: 'Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (user, project, local)'. Not needed: the scratch HOME is the only user scope and the workspace has no project settings. Left unset so both arms use the default.
help: 'Disable session persistence - sessions will not be saved to disk and cannot be resumed (only works with --print)'. Left off because decision D3 resumes by session id.

optional.comment: help: '-r, --resume [value]  Resume a conversation by session ID or name'. Needed only for decision D3 (one fixed reply, up to 2 times). Existence confirmed; resume behaviour under -p (cumulative total_cost_usd, session id kept) is from docs, not observed - see unverified.

help: '--max-budget-usd <amount>  Maximum dollar amount to spend on API calls (only works with --print)'. A possible second guard beside the token cap; not part of the shared argv. docs: result subtype 'error_max_budget_usd' when hit.

perRun.name: HOME
perRun.comment: Fresh mode-0700 directory per run (plan section 3). probe: with HOME=<scratch> and nothing else, claude created <scratch>/.claude and loaded no skills of the caller.

perRun.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
perRun.comment: docs (debug-your-config): 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/claude-clean/config claude ...' replaces ~/.claude for one launch. probe: with it set to <scratch>/.claude, the doflow install -g wrote and claude read skills/agents from there (init.skills and init.agents listed the DoFlow names).

perRun.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB
perRun.comment: docs (env-vars, read 2026-10-30 via context7 /websites/code_claude): '1' removes credentials (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, names or values that look like a credential, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) from the environments of the subprocesses Claude Code starts (Bash commands, hooks, stdio MCP servers); the Claude Code process keeps them for its own API calls. The name is also a string in the claude 2.1.308 binary. Set in both arms so a model that runs `env` does not print the credential. The executor also redacts every credential value and token shape from what it saves (execute.ts makeRedactor).

perRun.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
perRun.comment: docs (devcontainer): used in containerEnv to opt out of telemetry. probe: init.analytics_disabled was true with it set. Note (docs): it also disables feature-flag evaluation.

credential.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
credential.comment: probe: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was reported in init.apiKeySource. docs (authentication): 'Set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN ... token printed by claude setup-token'. The token is passed by environment only and never written to disk; the user approves the method at execution.

B.comment: probe, run in a scratch HOME on 804f7ca3: exit 0, '[INFO] claude: lifecycle verified (561 owned resource(s))', wrote <HOME>/.claude and <HOME>/.doflow. jq must be on PATH (hooks use it); bash is /bin/bash.

proof.comment: All fields below are read from the report of the parser (loadProof in claude-stream.ts).
proof.P2: init.skills and init.slash_commands list the DoFlow skills (do, do-implement, ...) and init.agents lists the archetypes (core-implementer, delivery-lead, quality-guardian, research-writer, reviewer, spec-analyst, system-architect). probe: confirmed in arm B; arm A lists only Claude built-ins (agents: claude, Explore, general-purpose, Plan, statusline-setup).
proof.P3: system/hook_response with hook_event SessionStart, outcome success, exit_code 0 (needs --include-hook-events). probe: observed in arm B, absent in arm A. The files DoFlow writes under <HOME>/.doflow/state/runs/<date>.jsonl are verb timing records (verb 'storage', exit_code, duration_ms), not a session-start record, so they are not used as P3.

unverified: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 also removes CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from hook and Bash subprocess environments (docs table). Arm B's DoFlow hooks then run without it and fall back to $HOME/.claude, which is the same directory because HOME is the scratch home; not observed on a real hook run. The first paid rehearsal should check that the SessionStart hook still succeeds in arm B.
Whether the scrub removes the oauth token from `env` output of a Bash command is from docs, not observed; the executor's redaction does not depend on it.

Whether AskUserQuestion is ever offered in -p runs here: probe shows it is absent from init.tools in both arms; docs (hooks) say -p offers it only with a permission host. So pauses show as a final message ending in '?', not as a tool call. The parser still counts AskUserQuestion calls if one appears.

Whether PreToolUse hooks fire under bypassPermissions in practice: docs say yes (hooks-guide, agent-sdk/permissions); no offline probe can make a tool call, so it is not observed. The first paid rehearsal should check a PreToolUse hook_response in arm B.

Whether tool_use blocks inside a subagent appear in the stream without --forward-subagent-text (help: '--forward-subagent-text  Forward subagent text and thinking blocks as assistant/user messages with parent_tool_use_id set'). The parser handles parent_tool_use_id when present; subagent token cost does not depend on it (modelUsage includes subagents per docs).

The assistant/user/result event shapes in test/fixtures/claude-headless/*.stream.jsonl are synthetic, built from the Agent SDK docs; only system/init, hook and api_retry lines are real (trimmed probe output). The first paid rehearsal transcript must be run through the parser as the real shape check.
--resume under -p: that total_cost_usd and modelUsage accumulate across resumes and the session id is kept is from docs (agent-sdk/cost-tracking), not observed.
DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 (docs devcontainer lists it; no observable effect in an offline probe), so it is not in the env list above.
The macOS keychain keying to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (plan section 3) was not re-read or probed here; the credential row above uses only the env-var path.
The 250k-per-run cap unit and per-run token figures: no real run exists.
